segments.title: Two smaller things, *also new*.
segments.cap: The identity, written and stamped after a first visit's opener; and Writing, in Chinese or English.
segments.capzh: 新的名号：第一次来时，开场之后先写再盖章；还有「在写」，中文、英文都能看。

beats.b: A first visit: the opener plays.
beats.a: A first visit: the same opener.
beats.azh: 第一次来：还是那段开场。

beats.b: It ends on the desk, the lockup already set in type.
beats.bzh: 落在书桌上，名字已经排好了。
beats.a: As it ends, the pen **writes the motto**, then the two seals are **stamped**.
beats.azh: 开场一结束，笔先写下那句话，再盖上两枚印章。

replay.note: replay · 0.4× speed · closer on the name
replay.b: The same seconds: “Fred Yang | 弗雷德”, the tagline and the ghost are simply there.
replay.bzh: 同样几秒：「Fred Yang | 弗雷德」、那句话和小幽灵，一直就在那儿。
replay.a: Slowed down: 继续写，继续造 in stroke order, then 弗雷德 and FRED YANG land on held frames, with their impact ticks.
replay.azh: 放慢看：「继续写，继续造」按笔顺写出来，再是「弗雷德」和「FRED YANG」两枚印一格一格地落下，带着冲击的短线。

segments.title: Writing · 中文 · EN
segments.zh: 在写 · 中文 · 英文

beats.b: Pull a book: its cover turns to you.
beats.bzh: 抽出一本书，封面转过来。
beats.a: Pull a book: its cover turns to you, **sharp** in your hand.
beats.azh: 抽出一本书，封面转过来，拿在手里是清楚的。

beats.b: The spines are Chinese only. There is no switch.
beats.bzh: 书脊只有中文，没有切换。
beats.a: The index now has a **中文 · EN** switch.
beats.azh: 索引上多了一个「中文 · EN」的切换。

beats.b: The same click lands on the count.
beats.a: EN: every spine and cover is retitled in English.
beats.azh: 点 EN：每本书的书脊和封面都换成英文标题。

beats.a: The next book opens in English, and Reading will too.
beats.azh: 下一本也是英文，点进去读也是英文。

beats.bzh: 也没有什么可以切回去。

replay.note: replay · closer on the book in your hand
replay.b: Closer: round one's cover is a small face scaled up, so it is soft.
replay.bzh: 凑近看：第一轮的封面是一张小图放大的，所以发虚。
replay.a: Closer: the book is laid out at its own size, so its type and its drawing are sharp.
replay.azh: 凑近看：书按它自己的尺寸排出来，字和画都是清楚的。
